name: Life Planner
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; npm ci && export CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous && (npx convex dev --once || true) && npx convex env set CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN "${CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN:-https://example.clerk.accounts.dev}" && npx convex dev --once && npx playwright install chromium

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; export CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous; npx convex dev --start 'vite dev --host'
terminals.description: Runs the local Convex backend and the Vite dev server (http://localhost:3000).
